selection: largest lower symmetric relative weight gap among exact admissible candidates with TV upper <=1/4; first on ties
fixed: outer endpoints and interval, physical B domain, normalization scale and known density
changed: inner landmarks, root and support nodes move together; fixed-inner-landmark condition of PR95 is relaxed
channel: all 90 interval counts, all overlaps of any order, optional total B count; selected-node causal order
stop: 40 exact conformal-flow candidates, no adaptive enlargement or Monte Carlo
